note: Vietnam's largest banks are the state banks (Vietcombank, BIDV, VietinBank, Agribank) and the large private banks (Techcombank, VPBank, MB, VIB, among the biggest card issuers). VIB's other cards' fee pages answered a 'Challenge Validation' page on 2026-10-30, which this research doesn't pass; VPBank's card page states no fee figures and Vietcombank's and Techcombank's card fee pages weren't found in this pass; so only VIB's One Card is written. VIB's fees and conditions for its One Card (read again 2026-10-30): the card has three tiers set by the holder's limit (Signature above 100 million dong, Platinum above 50 million up to 100 million, Gold up to 50 million), each written as a card (the Gold this file has held since 2026-10-29 is kept): the principal card's annual fee 2,999,000, 1,999,000 or 999,000 dong; purchases and cash 2.54% to 3.71% a month by credit history (cash drawn at a VIB branch POS 1.88% to 2.96%, not written); up to 55 days free of interest on purchases (the due date is 25, 20 or 15 days after the statement by tier; 55 is written for every tier); a cash advance 2.5%, 3% or 3.5%, at least 100,000 dong; spending in another currency 1%, 3% or 3.5% (the Signature's free for its first three statements, not written); over the limit 4% of the excess; a late payment 4%, 5% or 6% of the whole unpaid statement balance, at least 50,000 and at most 2,000,000 dong. A metal card's 1,500,000-dong issue fee and the design fees aren't written; the standard card is issued free. The page states no minimum payment. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): Shinhan Bank Vietnam and HSBC Vietnam, two large foreign banks' local banks that publish full card tariffs, are added; Techcombank's card fee annex (in force from 7 May 2026) was read but states no interest rate or late fee, so no Techcombank card is written; MB's site answers 403, VPBank's Incapsula's block, Sacombank's a captcha, and ACB's card tariff PDF a search found is gone (NoSuchKey); Vietcombank's and ACB's fee pages list their documents only by script (2026-10-30). Shinhan Bank Vietnam's personal credit card fee schedule (BIỂU PHÍ DỊCH VỤ THẺ TÍN DỤNG CÁ NHÂN, the PDF dated 23 July 2026 as served, read 2026-10-30, the columns checked by eye against the rendered pages): each card's principal annual fee, waived from the second year by the previous year's spending (written as a yearly fee waived by that spending): Shinhan Signature 2,500,000 dong (300 million), Travel Platinum 1,500,000 (110 million), Korean Air 1,100,000 (110 million), 365 Cashback, Hi-Point & Cash-Back Platinum, Tiki Platinum, MyLife and the Platinum card 1,100,000 each (110 million), Hi-Point Gold, Lotte Mart and Supreme 550,000 (55 million), Hi-Point Standard, Tiki Standard and BAEMIN 350,000 (35 million), the E-Card 429,000 (55 million), the Gold card 330,000 (55 million), the Standard card 110,000 (35 million); the PWM Platinum free; interest 25.8% (PWM), 24.99% (Signature), 30.8% (the platinum tier) or 33.8% (the gold and standard tier) a year; a cash advance 4%, at least 50,000 and at most 999,000 dong; spending in another currency 0.99% (PWM), 1.99% (Signature), 2.0% (365 Cashback) or 2.9%. A late payment of 4%, at least 250,000 and at most 999,000, doesn't name what it's a share of and isn't written; nor are the ATM, notification and inactive-account fees. The business cards aren't written; no minimum payment or grace period is stated. HSBC Vietnam's personal banking tariff (effective from 1 September 2026, fees including VAT, read 2026-10-30, its card section checked by eye against the rendered pages): the primary card's fee, TravelOne 1,650,000 dong, Platinum Online / Live+ and Cash Back 880,000, charged at issue and each year from the second (written as a yearly fee); the LiveFree 385,000 at issue, with no annual fee for cards booked from 1 April 2022 (written as the issue fee); finance charges 36.9% a year (TravelOne), 38.9% (Platinum Online / Live+, Cash Back) and 39.4% (LiveFree); a cash advance at an ATM 4%, at least 50,000; the minimum payment 1% of the outstanding balance, at least 50,000, plus instalments, finance charges, late and over-limit fees and any overdue or over-limit amount (written as 1% with a 50,000 floor and the interest added); a late charge 3% of the statement balance, at least 80,000 and at most 2,000,000; over the limit 100,000 (50,000 on the LiveFree); the administration fee on overseas transactions 1.99% (TravelOne) or 3.5% (Platinum / Live+, Cash Back); the tariff's 3.75% for the Visa Classic isn't written on the LiveFree, the tariff not saying the LiveFree is that card. Wave 5 (2026-10-30), minimum payments: VIB's One Card fees and conditions page (read 2026-10-30) sets the minimum as any monthly instalment, any overdue or over-limit amount, and 1% to 15% of the remaining statement balance (or another share VIB notifies each holder), written at the least, 1%, the share VIB sets for each holder being unknown to the game. No minimum payment is published for Shinhan Bank Vietnam's cards; tried: its card tariff (2026, no minimum), its home page (only the tariff linked), its personal credit card terms and conditions at the addresses a web search gave (REF.CARDTC-01, card_tac_vi.pdf, the 2019 and 2020 versions, the user guide and the application agreement, every one 404 or reset on 2026-10-30), a Vietnamese web search (Shinhan Finance's documents, another company), and archive.org (a 2024 snapshot of the 2018 terms exists, but web.archive.org is refused by this research's network).
